importantNote: Reduced Topbar width to 95% centered without changing zoom; increased height and upward positioning for Music Player & Nav dock.

changelog.category: Topbar & Floating Player/Nav Height & Position Optimization (v1.8.9)
items: Reduced Topbar (.topbar) width from 100% to 95% centered with margin 0 auto without modifying zoom.
Increased height of Music Mini-Player (.music-player) to 68px and shifted bottom position upward to 112px.
Increased height of Navigation Dock (.mobile-bottom-nav) to 68px and shifted bottom position upward to 28px.
Preserved 100% of music streaming backend logic.
Bumped service worker cache version to v126.
